name: Stephanie Jones

bio.statement: City council minutes from February 2025 list Jones as a Banks city councilor.
bio.excerpt: Niki Walters (Zoom), Pearcia Bogroff, and Stephanie Jones

source.publisher: City of Banks (City Council minutes, Feb. 11, 2025)

bio.statement: Banks Post reported in January 2025 that the council appointed Jones, a two-term former mayor, to the seat Kirk vacated.
bio.excerpt: Former Banks Mayor Stephanie Jones' second term as mayor ended two weeks ago on Dec. 31.

bio.statement: Jones's pamphlet statement lists work as a Hillsboro School District science teacher and substitute teacher.
bio.excerpt: Science Teacher, Hillsboro School District; Substitute teacher, multiple Washington County districts

bio.statement: Jones's pamphlet statement lists a master's in teaching science from Portland State and a B.A. from Western Oregon University.
bio.excerpt: Portland State University, MS in Teaching Science; Western Oregon University, BA in Integrated Studies

bio.statement: Jones's pamphlet statement lists prior service on the Banks City Council, as mayor and as budget committee chair.
bio.excerpt: Banks City Council; Mayor; Budget Committee Chair; Public Advisory Board;

positions.statement: In her voters' pamphlet statement, Jones says she strongly opposes data centers in Banks.
positions.excerpt: I am strongly opposed to data centers in Banks because I believe we can attract development

positions.statement: Jones's pamphlet statement supports planning that ensures water resources and infrastructure are available.
positions.excerpt: I believe in responsible planning, including ensuring water resources and infrastructure are available

positions.statement: Jones's pamphlet statement says she will encourage growth that supports local families and businesses.
positions.excerpt: I will encourage growth that strengthens our community, supports local families and businesses

collection_notes: Banks certification letter PDF returned no machine-readable text, and the city's council roster page (cityofbanks.org/meetmayor-council) blocks automated fetch. Incumbency is taken from the City of Banks council minutes of Feb. 11, 2025 (T1), which list Mayor Marsha Kirk and Councilors Peter Edison, Don Giannetti, Marilyn McCalister, Niki Walters, Pearcia Bogroff and Stephanie Jones. Banks Post (bankspost.com, bylined local newspaper by Chas Hundley) is treated as T3. Step 5 searches found no coverage of Banks candidates in the fixed outlet groups. Banks Post (Jan. 14, 2025) reports she was appointed to Position CC1 with a term ending Dec. 31, 2026 (appointed incumbent, matching inventory). Common name: generic searches returned unrelated people.
